title: Taiwanese Association of America San Antonio 聖安東尼 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of America San Antonio (TAASA) is a chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization of Taiwanese American community associations. TAASA serves the Taiwanese American community in the San Antonio, Texas area and is listed under the TAA’s Southern region (美南).
